up: List all approved drugs indicated for prostate cancer. For each drug, provide the ChEMBL ID, the preferred name, the canonical SMILES, and the indication details (mesh_heading and efo_term). An approved drug is defined as having max_phase = 4. The results should be distinct rows for each drug-indication pair.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  di.mesh_heading,
  di.efo_term
FROM drug_indication di
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON di.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.mesh_heading = 'Prostatic Neoplasms';
